# Crypto: WebSocket API Reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/sync-docs.mjs on 2026-10-15 from https://massive.com/docs/llms.txt. Do not edit by hand. -->

5 WebSocket endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Feeds

### Aggregates (Per Minute)

`XA.<ticker>` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/crypto` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/crypto/aggregates-per-minute.md)

Stream minute-by-minute aggregated OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for a specified cryptocurrency pair via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a crypto pair in the format {from}-{to} or use * to subscribe to all crypto pairs. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple crypto pairs. You can retrieve active crypto tickers from our Crypto Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev pair o c h l v s e vw z`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time

### Aggregates (Per Second)

`XAS.<ticker>` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/crypto` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/crypto/aggregates-per-second.md)

Stream second-by-second aggregated OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for a specified cryptocurrency pair via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a crypto pair in the format {from}-{to} or use * to subscribe to all crypto pairs. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple crypto pairs. You can retrieve active crypto tickers from our Crypto Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev pair o c h l v s e vw z`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time

### Fair Market Value

`FMV.<ticker>` · Business `wss://business.massive.com/crypto` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/crypto/fair-market-value.md)

Stream real-time Fair Market Value (FMV) data for a specified cryptocurrency pair via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a crypto pair in the format {from}-{to} or use * to subscribe to all crypto pairs. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple crypto pairs. You can retrieve active crypto tickers from our Crypto Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev fmv sym t`
- **Plan:** Business plans only (Currencies Business) · recency Real-time

### Quotes

`XQ.<ticker>` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/crypto` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/crypto/quotes.md)

Stream quote data for specified cryptocurrency pairs via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a crypto pair in the format {from}-{to} or use * to subscribe to all crypto pairs. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple crypto pairs. You can retrieve active crypto tickers from our Crypto Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev pair bp bs ap as t x r`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time

### Trades

`XT.<ticker>` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/crypto` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/crypto/trades.md)

Stream trade data for crypto pairs via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a crypto pair in the format {from}-{to} or use * to subscribe to all crypto pairs. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple crypto pairs. You can retrieve active crypto tickers from our Crypto Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev pair p t s c i x r`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time
